notes.title: Your suggestions to the developer.
notes.notes:
Hello. My name is Roman. 
I am an individual developer from some cold country.

If you have any comments on the current state of the game or suggestions for further development, I would be very happy to see them here. I will try to put as many of your wishes as possible in the next additions, at least as far as technically possible. 

Thanks in advance. ;)
